page_title: OSA 1-0 RAY | Osasuna v Rayo Vallecano 15/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Golden chance! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
90+6' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Raul (Osasuna) gets booked.
90+5' 1 - 0 Raul (Osasuna) manages to rise above the opponent's defenders to meet the well-taken corner kick with his head. His effort goes inside the right post. What a finish!
90+5' Osasuna force their opponents to concede a corner.

90+5' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
90+3' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.

90+2' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Osasuna.

90+1' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Stole Dimitrievski makes a great save to stop his effort.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
89' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) heads on.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raul de Tomas leaves the pitch and Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
88' Substitution. Isi Palazon makes his way off the pitch and Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) comes on as his replacement.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Aimar Oroz will be replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
84' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nacho Vidal (Osasuna) replacing Ruben Pena.
84' Here comes a substitution. Raul (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Chimy Avila.
84' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
83' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
83' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Osasuna.
79' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
78' The ball goes out for a corner. Osasuna can continue in their attacking effort.
78' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Osasuna.
76' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
74' The foul by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Javier Iglesias Villanueva.
74' A short through ball almost allows Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
73' Francisco has decided to substitute Pathe Ciss and he is replaced by Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
72' Substitution. Alvaro Garcia makes way for Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
72' What a miss! The corner finds David Garcia (Osasuna) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
72' Osasuna have a corner.
70' Stole Dimitrievski makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) after a cross from the side.
69' The referee signals a substitution. Jose Manuel Arnaiz is brought on as a substitute for Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
69' Today's match ends for Moi Gomez (Osasuna) who will be replaced by Jon Moncayola.
67' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
66' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight and sees a foul from Chimy Avila (Osasuna). Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
66' A cross into the box from Ruben Pena (Osasuna) is cleared.
64' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
63' Francisco has decided to make a change. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Kike Perez.
61' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
59' Rayo Vallecano fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.
55' The whistle blows and Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is booked for an infringement.
55' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) sees a yellow card from Javier Iglesias Villanueva after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
55' Great save! Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Sergio Herrera.
53' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
53' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
53' Osasuna are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
50' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
47' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Rayo Vallecano was in an offside position.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Stole Dimitrievski, who smothers the ball.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
44' A player from Osasuna commits a rough challenge. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Rayo Vallecano.
43' The game is interrupted now, Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' A player from Rayo Vallecano commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
40' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) gets a yellow card.
40' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
40' The fouls committed statistics – 6:8.
38' The shot by Ruben Pena (Osasuna) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Stole Dimitrievski.
37' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
36' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul.
34' It's a throw-in for Osasuna.
31' What an opportunity! Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which goes just over the crossbar!
30' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
30' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rayo Vallecano.
28' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
27' Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupts the game. One of the players from Osasuna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
24' PENALTY APPEAL by Osasuna, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
23' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) serves up a nice cross, but Stole Dimitrievski punches the ball away.
22' A player from Osasuna commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
22' The ball is out of play and Osasuna manage to earn a corner.
21' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
19' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
19' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
18' Osasuna are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
16' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Javier Iglesias Villanueva signals a set piece.
16' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
14' A player from Osasuna commits a rough challenge. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
10' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
9' Rayo Vallecano have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
9' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
8' Osasuna concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
6' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
4' Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupts the game. One of the players from Rayo Vallecano won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
3' The ball crosses the sideline and it is going to be a throw-in.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Rayo Vallecano will kick the game off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
